note: Provisional HR policy values for a staging or demo site, modelled on Eswatini practice (Employment Act 1980, Code of Good Practice on discipline, a parastatal's conditions of service). Not ESWASA's signed values. Each value is written only where the site has none, so HR's own changes stay.

disciplinary_offences.title: Late coming or leaving work early without permission
Absence without leave or a valid reason (one or two days)
Absence without leave for more than three working days in thirty
Failure to carry out a reasonable instruction
Reporting for duty under the influence of alcohol or drugs
Gross negligence causing loss, damage or risk
Misuse of Authority vehicles, equipment or property
Falsifying test, calibration, audit or certification records
Accepting gifts, favours or payment from clients
Undisclosed conflict of interest (breach of impartiality)
Disclosure of confidential client or certification information
Breach of laboratory health and safety rules
Breach of the ICT acceptable-use policy

letter_wording.Probation confirmation letter: We are pleased to confirm that you have completed your probation as {designation} in the {department} department. Your appointment is confirmed with effect from {final_confirmation_date}. All other terms of your employment, which began on {date_of_joining}, remain as set out in your contract and the Authority's conditions of service. We thank you for your contribution so far and wish you continued success.
letter_wording.Contract renewal letter: Further to the review of your fixed-term contract as {designation} in the {department} department, which was due to end on {current_end_date}, we are pleased to renew it to {new_end_date}. All other terms remain as set out in your contract and the Authority's conditions of service. Please sign and return a copy of this letter to Human Resources.
letter_wording.Permanent appointment letter: We are pleased to inform you that your appointment as {designation} in the {department} department has been made {new_employment_type}. Your continuous service counts from {date_of_joining}. All other terms remain as set out in the Authority's conditions of service. Please sign and return a copy of this letter to Human Resources.
letter_wording.Promotion letter: We are pleased to inform you that you have been promoted to {designation} in the {department} department, grade {grade}, with effect from {promotion_date}. Your new duties will be explained by your line manager. All other terms of your employment remain as set out in your contract and the Authority's conditions of service. Congratulations on your promotion.
letter_wording.Transfer letter: This letter confirms your transfer to the {department} department as {designation}, based at {branch}, with effect from {transfer_date}. Your grade, continuous service and other terms of employment are not affected. Please report to your new line manager on that date.
letter_wording.Warning letter: Following the disciplinary hearing held on {outcome_on}, you were found to have committed the offence of {offence_title}. In terms of the Authority's disciplinary code you are issued with a {sanction}. This warning remains on your file until {warning_expires_on}, after which it will no longer be taken into account. A repeat of this or a related offence while the warning is active may lead to more serious action. You have the right to appeal in writing within five working days of receiving this letter.
letter_wording.Employment confirmation letter: This is to confirm that {employee_name}, staff number {employee_number}, is employed by the Eswatini Standards Authority as {designation} in the {department} department, on a {employment_type} basis, and has been employed since {date_of_joining}. This letter is issued at the employee's request for the purpose stated ({purpose}) and confirms employment details only.
